The '''''Calvary''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==History==
It served at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
